name: qdroid
description: Portable agent application runtime for robot hosts

scripts.format: prettier --write --ignore-unknown package.json tsconfig.json .prettierrc.json THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md packages apps adapters fixtures tests scripts profiles/hosts docs/USAGE.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check --ignore-unknown package.json tsconfig.json .prettierrc.json THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md packages apps adapters fixtures tests scripts profiles/hosts docs/USAGE.md
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/tests/contracts/*.test.js dist/tests/admission/*.test.js dist/tests/recovery/*.test.js
scripts.test:admission: npm run build && node --test dist/tests/admission/*.test.js dist/tests/recovery/*.test.js
scripts.test:linux: npm run build && node scripts/require-linux-image.mjs && node --test --test-concurrency=1 dist/tests/linux/admission/*.test.js dist/tests/linux/qualification/*.test.js
scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/apps/cli/src/index.js demo
scripts.linux:demo: npm run build && node dist/apps/cli/src/index.js linux-demo
scripts.sandbox:demo: npm run build && node dist/apps/cli/src/index.js sandbox-demo
